ModMetaData.name: RimWorld: SCP Foundation — Ouroboros
ModMetaData.author: Zokl17
ModMetaData.description:
Contain and study SCP anomalies, build secure facilities, and work with the Foundation through the Ouroboros story. Discover new objects, research, equipment, factions, raids and quests during regular RimWorld play.
Supports RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7 (testing ongoing for 1.7). Requires the separate Harmony mod; some content uses installed DLC.
Unofficial fan project based on SCP Wiki works (CC BY-SA 3.0). Authors, sources and full license information: README.md, CREDITS.md and LICENSE.md.
